updates.original_task: Build two consumers with static-inline helper and exactly one external API definition; take helper addresses and inspect symbol ownership.
updates.closure_rationale: Distinct internal function/static-object identities across separately compiled consumers and exactly one external definition, plus unsigned/unchanged-output controls.
evidence_limits: Hosted C17 baseline; GNU17 and explicit -fgnu89-inline are isolated dialect experiments. N1570 is inspected C11 draft, not exact published C17/C23.
GNU89 external-body behavior and ELF nm letters are implementation observations; ISO obligations are classified separately.
Call-only missing-definition executables are never executed even if optimization permits linking.
Only original local array target receives invalid index4, in a separate AddressSanitizer process; no arbitrary-code-execution claim.
C and C.utf8 are distinct installed locales but both produce English diagnostics here; no untranslated language coverage claim.
Static analyzer uncertainty is demonstrated, not a proof of absence; finite compiler/ABI/input matrix does not establish mastery.
No external review, independent delayed learner assessment, or physical observation.
